# Project Phoenix v45.0 — Global Situation 1: Global Silver Flow & Price Revolution (1550-1700).
# Pure native EU5 1.4.9 Interactive Situation (`is_data_map = yes`, live `oe_v45_silver_index` 0..100).
# Generated by gen_v450_world_situations.py; edit the generator, not this file.

oe_sit_v45_global_silver_flow = {
	monthly_spawn_chance = monthly_spawn_chance_unique
	hint_tag = hint_oe_sit_v45_global_silver_flow

	can_start = {
		current_year >= 1550
		current_year <= 1700
		NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_v45_silver_ended }
		any_country = {
			is_rebel_country = no
			num_locations >= 12
			OR = {
				any_owned_location = {
					raw_material ?= goods:silver
					OR = {
						continent = continent:america
						region = region:japan_region
					}
				}
				AND = {
					is_great_power = yes
					capital ?= {
						OR = {
							continent = continent:europe
							sub_continent = sub_continent:east_asia
							sub_continent = sub_continent:south_asia
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	visible = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		NOT = { oe_is_fourth_rome_isolated_phase = yes }
		NOT = { country_type = pop }
		NOT = { country_type = building }
		OR = {
			is_ai = no
			is_great_power = yes
			any_owned_location = { raw_material ?= goods:silver }
			capital ?= {
				OR = {
					continent = continent:europe
					sub_continent = sub_continent:east_asia
					sub_continent = sub_continent:south_asia
					continent = continent:america
				}
			}
		}
	}

	# Outcome 1: Stabilized Global Silver Standard (oe_v45_silver_index >= 85)
	outcome = {
		name = "oe_v45_silver_end_global_standard"
		desc = "oe_v45_silver_end_global_standard_desc"
		trigger = {
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { has_variable = oe_v45_silver_index }
				var:oe_v45_silver_index >= 85
			}
			trigger_else = { always = no }
		}
		immediate = {
			set_global_variable = { name = oe_v45_silver_ended value = 1 }
			every_country = {
				limit = {
					is_rebel_country = no
					NOT = { oe_is_fourth_rome_isolated_phase = yes }
					OR = {
						is_ai = no
						is_great_power = yes
						has_variable = oe_v45_silver_participant
					}
				}
				add_prestige = 12
				add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_v45_mod_silver_global_standard years = 30 mode = replace }
			}
		}
	}

	# Outcome 2: Protracted Price Revolution (late 17th c. with low bullion integration)
	outcome = {
		name = "oe_v45_silver_end_price_shock"
		desc = "oe_v45_silver_end_price_shock_desc"
		trigger = {
			current_year >= 1685
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { has_variable = oe_v45_silver_index }
				var:oe_v45_silver_index < 35
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
		}
		immediate = {
			set_global_variable = { name = oe_v45_silver_ended value = 2 }
			every_country = {
				limit = {
					is_rebel_country = no
					NOT = { oe_is_fourth_rome_isolated_phase = yes }
					OR = {
						is_ai = no
						is_great_power = yes
						has_variable = oe_v45_silver_participant
					}
				}
				add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_v45_mod_silver_price_adjustment years = 25 mode = replace }
			}
		}
	}

	# Outcome 3: Seventeenth-Century Bullion Equilibrium (1700 safety horizon)
	outcome = {
		name = "oe_v45_silver_end_equilibrium"
		desc = "oe_v45_silver_end_equilibrium_desc"
		trigger = {
			current_year >= 1700
		}
		immediate = {
			set_global_variable = { name = oe_v45_silver_ended value = 3 }
			every_country = {
				limit = {
					is_rebel_country = no
					NOT = { oe_is_fourth_rome_isolated_phase = yes }
					OR = {
						is_ai = no
						is_great_power = yes
						has_variable = oe_v45_silver_participant
					}
				}
				add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_v45_mod_silver_price_adjustment years = 20 mode = replace }
			}
		}
	}

	on_start = {
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_v45_silver_started value = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = oe_v45_silver_index value = 35 }
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				is_ai = no
				is_rebel_country = no
				NOT = { oe_is_fourth_rome_isolated_phase = yes }
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_v45_ws_1_seen }
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_v45_ws_1_seen value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = oe_v45_silver_participant value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = oe_v45_ws_ev_cd value = 1 days = 420 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_v45_ws.1
		}
	}

	on_monthly = {
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_v45_silver_index } } set_variable = { name = oe_v45_silver_index value = 35 } }
		if = {
			limit = {
				var:oe_v45_silver_index < 78
				any_country = {
					is_rebel_country = no
					OR = {
						has_country_modifier = oe_v45_mod_manila_galleon_charter
						has_country_modifier = oe_v45_mod_amsterdam_exchange
						has_country_modifier = oe_v45_mod_mint_debasement_curbs
					}
				}
			}
			change_variable = { name = oe_v45_silver_index add = 0.25 }
		}
		if = { limit = { var:oe_v45_silver_index > 100 } set_variable = { name = oe_v45_silver_index value = 100 } }
		if = { limit = { var:oe_v45_silver_index < 0 } set_variable = { name = oe_v45_silver_index value = 0 } }
	}

	on_ended = {
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_v45_silver_ended } }
			set_global_variable = { name = oe_v45_silver_ended value = 3 }
		}
	}

	tooltip = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					raw_material ?= goods:silver
					region = region:andes_region
					region = region:mesoamerica_region
					region = region:japan_region
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = oe_v45_silver_map_producers_tt
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					region = region:iberia_region
					region = region:france_region
					region = region:great_britain_region
					region = region:north_german_region
					region = region:italy_region
					region = region:balkan_region
					region = region:anatolia_region
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = oe_v45_silver_map_forwarders_tt
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					sub_continent = sub_continent:east_asia
					sub_continent = sub_continent:south_asia
					sub_continent = sub_continent:south_east_asia
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = oe_v45_silver_map_absorbers_tt
		}
	}

	is_data_map = yes
	map_color = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					raw_material ?= goods:silver
					region = region:andes_region
					region = region:mesoamerica_region
					region = region:japan_region
				}
			}
			value = yellow_light
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					region = region:iberia_region
					region = region:france_region
					region = region:great_britain_region
					region = region:north_german_region
					region = region:italy_region
					region = region:balkan_region
					region = region:anatolia_region
				}
			}
			value = blue_mid
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					sub_continent = sub_continent:east_asia
					sub_continent = sub_continent:south_asia
					sub_continent = sub_continent:south_east_asia
				}
			}
			value = green
		}
		else = {
			value = define:NMapColors|DEFAULT_COLOR
		}
	}

	legend_key = {
		desc = "oe_v45_silver_legend_producers"
		color = rgb { 228 202 104 }
	}
	legend_key = {
		desc = "oe_v45_silver_legend_forwarders"
		color = rgb { 62 126 196 }
	}
	legend_key = {
		desc = "oe_v45_silver_legend_absorbers"
		color = rgb { 54 158 134 }
	}
}
